// diagnostic

E0403

A fallible value or operation does not fit the enclosing failure domain

What

A fallible value or operation does not fit the enclosing failure domain

Why

A fallible operation must either match the enclosing failure domain or be handled before it leaves the current context.

Fix

Handle the failure locally, or declare a compatible failure domain in the enclosing return type.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0403: tests/ui/taskgroup_parameter_escape.stderr.

Error [E1110]: `group` is a `Group` and cannot escape in a lambda
  --> tests/ui/taskgroup_parameter_escape.jet:3:46
    |
  3 | fn escape(group: Group) fn() Int -> { return () -> use_group(group) }
    |                                              ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: a task group is a scoped spawn authority that may flow only through a direct function or method parameter
 Fix: move this work to a function or method that takes `group: Group` and call it directly
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1110

Error [E0403]: this fallible call only works inside a function that returns a fallible result
  --> tests/ui/taskgroup_parameter_escape.jet:3:52
    |
  3 | fn escape(group: Group) fn() Int -> { return () -> use_group(group) }
    |                                                    ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: ordinary fallible calls propagate their failure automatically to the caller
 Fix: declare `Err` in the return type before `->`, or handle the result with `??`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0403
